concerns.text: FR-002 – System MUST map semantic embeddings into a discrete SymbolicState. No task in tasks.md implements this conversion (e.g., a mapping module or validation step).

FR-006 – System MUST log the specific step where a real‑world execution failure occurs and label the failure mode. No task (e.g., T024) provides concrete failure‑detection logic or writes to `execution_logs.parquet`.
FR-009 – System MUST implement a Sim‑to‑Real Adapter or fine‑tuning protocol for the low‑level controller. No task addresses this adapter (e.g., a fine‑tuning or domain‑shift task).
FR-011 – System MUST detect ambiguous or non‑unique embedding‑to‑SymbolicState mappings and log `AmbiguousMapping`. No task (e.g., T013/T015) includes this detection logic.
FR-013 – System MUST evaluate precision and recall of the embedding‑to‑SymbolicState mapping against a ground‑truth dataset. No task is defined to perform this evaluation.
FR-016 – System MUST evaluate the Neural Policy using the deterministic Oracle. No task is assigned to run the Neural Policy against the Oracle or record the results.
FR-017 – System MUST obtain baseline GPU‑based compute metrics for percentage‑reduction calculations. No task collects or records these GPU baseline metrics.
SC-003 – Memory usage and CPU utilization must be measured for the execution phase. Existing tasks only monitor planning memory (T022); execution‑phase metrics are absent.
SC-006 – The Physics Fidelity Gap (Oracle success rate minus Real‑World success rate) must be measured. No task (e.g., T041) is defined to compute or report this gap.
SC-007 – Total wall‑clock time for all 18 real‑world tasks must be ≤ 4 hours. No task records or validates the aggregate wall‑clock time.
The Dependency Map references task IDs T010 and T014, but these tasks are not defined anywhere in tasks.md, creating stale references.
